title: Democratic Impact Monitor: National Universal Free Healthcare and Medical Integrity Bill, 2026
objective: Track universal free healthcare delivery, private tariff compliance, 15km/30km facility radius density, AI prescription auditing fairness, and EHR privacy security.
affected_groups: Patients across urban and rural India
Public health service medical professionals and staff
Private healthcare establishments and diagnostic laboratories

indicators.name: Out-of-Pocket Expenditure (OOPE) Reduction
indicators.definition: Proportion of total household health spending out-of-pocket across public and private facilities.
indicators.data_source: National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) Health Rounds & National Health Accounts
indicators.publication: Publicly published on National Health Portal
indicators.independent_validation: Independent academic evaluation by Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)

indicators.name: Public Infrastructure Density Compliance
indicators.definition: Percentage of urban populations within 15 km and rural populations within 30 km of a functional ultra-modern public healthcare facility.
indicators.data_source: GIS Spatial Mapping & State Health Infrastructure Dashboards
indicators.independent_validation: Auditor General of India physical verification

oversight.body: National Universal Health Authority Oversight Committee
oversight.composition: Public health experts, judicial nominees, patient advocates, CAG representatives
oversight.powers: Statutory audit, spot inspections, subpoena records, issue binding corrective directions

complaints.channel: National Healthcare Grievance Redressal Portal & Ombudsman
complaints.appeal_route: District Health Ombudsman -> State Health Rights Tribunal

triggers.condition: Facility density shortfall exceeding 10% in any district or private overcharging complaints exceeding threshold.
triggers.detector: National Health Infrastructure GIS & Grievance Redressal Portal
triggers.interim_protection: Emergency financial allocation from National Universal Health Trust Fund
triggers.correction: Mandatory directive to State Administration to establish temporary mobile surgical/diagnostic units
triggers.public_notice: Immediate public report published on National Health Portal

review.reporting_to: Parliament of India (Joint Parliamentary Committee on Health)
